name: Tricolore
source:
One day, our hero receives a package from his father, the scientist. He opens it up to find a robot in the form of a girl. Her name is Shizu. His father asks him to monitor, teach, and train the robot. So begins the life of our hero and his robot. It all starts out with a lot of fun, but there is a secret hidden inside this robot: She has 3 separate personalities!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020613204000/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ta/tricolore/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
translation:
有一天，我们的英雄收到了他科学家父亲寄来的包裹。他打开它，发现一个女孩形状的机器人。她的名字叫希祖。他的父亲要求他监视、教导和训练机器人。我们的英雄和他的机器人的生活就这样开始了。一切一开始都很有趣，但这个机器人内部隐藏着一个秘密：她有3个不同的性格！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020613204000/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ta/tricolore/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
